name: Office
author: Rick McElvana
summary: Makes and edits Word documents and spreadsheets in the folders the person opened for writing; use it when they ask for a document, a list or a sheet.

schedules.taskPrompt: It is a weekday morning. Look at their plans with plan_list and at today's schedules with schedule_list. If one of their Files folders has a document called Plan or To do, read it with files__read_document (files__search_files finds it). Then tell them, in two or three sentences, what today holds and the one thing to start with.

schedules.description: Sunday evening: the week's digest, as a document
schedules.taskPrompt: It is Sunday evening. Write this week's digest as a Word document with files__write_document, in the first folder files__list_allowed_directories says you may write in, named "Week of" and this week's Monday as a date, like "Week of 2026-11-02.docx". In it: a # title, a ## section for what got done and what is still open in their plans (plan_list), and a ## section for what is coming next week (schedule_list). Keep it to one page. Then tell them in one sentence that it is there and its name.
